referee_ratings_dimension_range.name: referee_ratings_dimension_range
referee_ratings_dimension_range.value: "referee_ratings"."overall" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "referee_ratings"."game_control" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "referee_ratings"."communication" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND "referee_ratings"."fairness" BETWEEN 1 AND 5

incidents_subject_shape.name: incidents_subject_shape
incidents_subject_shape.value: ("incidents"."subject_type" = 'participant' AND "incidents"."subject_family_member_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("incidents"."subject_type" <> 'participant' AND "incidents"."subject_free_text_name" IS NOT NULL)

family_members_self_xor_parent.name: family_members_self_xor_parent
family_members_self_xor_parent.value: ("family_members"."parent_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "family_members"."self_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("family_members"."parent_user_id" IS NULL AND "family_members"."self_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

games_non_negative_scores.name: games_non_negative_scores
games_non_negative_scores.value: ("games"."home_score" IS NULL OR "games"."home_score" >= 0) AND ("games"."away_score" IS NULL OR "games"."away_score" >= 0)

program_gear_exactly_one_target.name: program_gear_exactly_one_target
program_gear_exactly_one_target.value: (program_id IS NOT NULL)::int + (season_id IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

media_tags_unique_team.name: media_tags_unique_team
media_tags_unique_team.where: "media_tags"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_tags"."family_member_id" IS NULL

time_entries_referee_iff_game_id.name: time_entries_referee_iff_game_id
time_entries_referee_iff_game_id.value: ("time_entries"."role" = 'referee' AND "time_entries"."game_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("time_entries"."role" <> 'referee' AND "time_entries"."game_id" IS NULL)
